quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at an intersection with a red left arrow, what should you do?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to other drivers.
Stop completely and proceed when it is safe.
Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow is lit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow is lit.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must stop before the intersection. Do not move while the red arrow is showing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road splits into two directions. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow signs warn you of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers near work areas.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has a series of curves.
There will be more traffic ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A side road enters from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does a five-sided sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts you to a school zone. It warns that children may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light is allowed with caution.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line over a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: You are going the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
Do not proceed until it turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop and yield to all traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright clothing and use paddles and flags to direct traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs indicate school zones or school crossings. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Right turns allowed on red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. It is illegal to turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop if necessary before proceeding.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits turns in the direction shown. Right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you should not go. You may see it on one-way streets or expressway ramps if you try to enter the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Get ready to change lanes or shift position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is coming. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of a steep hill coming. Slow down and be ready to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A downgrade or hill is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downgrade or hill is coming.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long downgrade or hill ahead.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles may cross your path.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Go at your normal speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen. Slow down and be ready to stop if a train is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone starts after the curve.
Do not drive slower than 35 mph around the curve.
Go 35 mph or slower around the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go 35 mph or slower around the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the recommended speed for the curve ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; a curving road is ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What message appears on a red eight-sided sign?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability placards or special license plates.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you another road crosses ahead. Slow down and prepare to yield or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road work or maintenance is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond signs warn of construction or maintenance work areas. Fines may be doubled in these zones.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing downward is a yield sign. Slow down and stop if needed.

questions.question: When displayed on the back of a vehicle, this sign means:

options.text: An animal is pulling the vehicle.
The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This emblem on a vehicle warns that it moves at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction areas. Proceed with caution.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead ends at an intersection. Slow down and prepare to turn or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on vehicles that travel slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line over a symbol means that action is prohibited. Left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign directs traffic to keep right of an island or barrier. The road ahead is divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign indicates a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You may only drive straight ahead.
You may turn left or drive straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left or drive straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your lane splitting into two directions. You can turn left or go straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You may turn left only on a green arrow.
You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
You must wait for a solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yield means slow down and be ready to stop. After yielding, follow the other directions on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel either direction in this lane.
Traffic moves both directions on this road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves both directions on this road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: A construction or maintenance area is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction or maintenance area is coming.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of upcoming hazards. Orange signs indicate construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve where the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you of school zones and crossings. When you see this sign, be alert and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers to areas where bicycles may cross.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of traffic that may merge ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give them extra space to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road. You should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give them extra space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you to traffic merging into your lane. Check your sides and rear. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers clear space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular yellow sign with black lettering marks a no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-way, two-lane roads where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always warns of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign showing a traffic signal warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead turns sharply at a severe angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply at a severe angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a sharp change in road direction. Slow down and prepare for the sharp turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a side road will intersect ahead. Be alert for traffic entering from the side.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on any road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the way is clear.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. These warn of upcoming conditions, including sharp curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic comes toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only" below it, what should you do?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you that you must move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange is the color for work zones. This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this yellow sign?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be aware and stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that must be obeyed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for vehicles on the other road to pass. You do not need to stop if no vehicles are coming, but slow down and enter with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be prepared to allow the incoming traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the number of lanes is reduced ahead. Traffic should merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Stop before the crosswalk or intersection if there is no line. Only proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that must be obeyed. This sign shows the maximum speed limit. You may drive slower based on conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign marks a crosswalk. Be alert and allow pedestrians to cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that must be obeyed. This sign prohibits turning right or left on a red signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of an upcoming intersection so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: All roads are slippery when wet. This sign warns of dangerous wet conditions. Slow down because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles use hand and arm signals. A left arm straight out means a left turn.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs are service signs. They provide information about motorist services like rest areas, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road to the bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean about passing other vehicles?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.
You cannot pass for any reason.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass for any reason.
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows traffic laws that must be obeyed. This sign prohibits passing completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns to be careful on wet pavement because it becomes slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a change in road direction or a narrowing of the road. You may see this on the outside of a sharp curve or near a narrow bridge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon merge into one.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: A red sign shows that an action is prohibited. This sign means you are traveling the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: At a flashing yellow light, slow down and proceed carefully. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then left. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, what should you do?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: What does an orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows important traffic rules that must be obeyed. This sign tells drivers to keep the left lane open for faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is beginning.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangular sign is always a yield sign. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a winding road. Adjust your speed appropriately.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
You will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
You should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and prepare to stop. Wait for trains to pass before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn of upcoming hazards. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.
